_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro:
I bɛ jwɛrɛ Golf (Kari Jɛri) - Jwɛrɛ {player_id}.
Kɛlɛ: I bɛna kɛnɛ kɔnɔ kɛlɛ walima sɔrɔ dɔ la. Ni kɔlɔn bɛɛ ka wɛlɛ kelen, u bɛna sɔrɔ 0.
Kari kɛlɛ: A=1, 2-10=kari kɛlɛ, J/Q=10, K=0

Actions (kɛlɛ bracket ɛ):
- '[draw]' - Kari ka sɔrɔ deck la
- '[take]' - Kari ka sɔrɔ discard pile la
- '[swap X Y]' - Kari ka sɔrɔ X (sɛri) Y (kɔlɔn)
- '[discard]' - Kari ka discard

board.drew:
I kɛɛ: {card}
Kɔɔri, i ka [swap X Y] wala [discard] a.
board.took:
I kɛɛ: {card} kɔɔri kɔɔri
I ka [swap X Y] a (tɛ kɛɛ kaadi kɔɔri).

options.final_turns: Kɔɔri kɔɔri! I kɛɛw: [draw], [take], [peek X Y]
options.must_swap: I ka kan: [swap X Y] (i tɛ se ka karitiw bɔ i yɛrɛ la)

message.knocked: Ɲininkɛla {pid} ka ɲε! Jigininkɛ tɔ kelen bɛɛ ye jɔsi dɔ wɛrɛ ta.
message.final_round: Jwɛrɛ {pid} {reason}! Jwɛrɛ kelen o kɔnɔ, u bɛna taa kelen

invalid.wrong_action: Kɛlɛ kelen bracketed action kan: [draw], [take], [swap X Y], [discard], [knock], walima [peek X Y]
invalid.must_draw_first: I ka kɛɛ kaadi kɔɔri. I ka [draw], [take], [knock], wala [peek X Y]
invalid.cannot_discard_taken: I tɛ kɛɛ kaadi kɔɔri kɔɔri. I ka kɛɛ a.
invalid.have_drawn_card: I kɛɛ kaadi. I ka [swap X Y] wala [discard] a.
invalid.need_drawn_swap: I mako be sɛbɛri la walisa k'a yira ko i ye jurumukɛla ye.
invalid.need_drawn_discard: I mako be fɛɛn dɔ la walisa ka se k'o fili.
invalid.out_of_bounds: Sɔrɔ tɛ kɛɛ. Kɔɔri sɔrɔ 1-{max_row}, kolɔn 1-{max_col}
invalid.knock_with_card: I tɛ se ka dɔ bɔ i bolo n'i ma juru don.
invalid.already_knocked: Mɔgɔ dɔ ye ɲinan ta ban.

board_str.title: === JIGI GOLFI KƐNƆ=== N'a sɔrɔ a ye nɛnɛkiri.
board_str.discard: Fɛɛn minw be fili, u ka kan k'u bila: {card}
